import datetime,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,sys
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();pair=root.parent;runtime=pathlib.Path(os.environ['NET05A_RUN_DIR']);ev=runtime/'evidence'
meta=json.loads((pair/'remote-snapshots.json').read_text())
assert (pair/'command.exit').read_text().strip()=='0'
for item in meta['sources']['network']['files']:
 f=root/item['path'];assert hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==item['sha256'],item['path']
assert not (pair/'live-api-wave.exit').exists()
assert (pair/'live-resumed.exit').read_text().strip()=='1'
api_program="import importlib.util,os,pathlib\nroot=pathlib.Path(os.environ['NETWORK_SOURCE'])\nsp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('adapter',root/'scripts/net05a-adapt.py');adapter=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp);sp.loader.exec_module(adapter)\nbody=adapter.adapted('api')\nassert body.count(\"state['id']\")==12 and body.count('import concurrent.futures')==1\nbody=body.replace('import concurrent.futures','import concurrent.futures\\nimport os')\nbody=body.replace(\"state['id']\", \"(state['id']+('-'+os.environ['NET05A_WAVE'] if os.environ.get('NET05A_WAVE') else ''))\")\npath=str(root/'scripts/net05a-api.py')\nexec(compile(body,path,'exec'),{'__file__':path,'__name__':'__main__'})\n"
commands = [[sys.executable,'-B','-c',api_program],[sys.executable,'-B','scripts/net05a-cleanup.py','permissions']]
commands += [[sys.executable,'-B','scripts/net05a-live.py',stage] for stage in ['setup-faults','queries','transactions','lease','unknown','provider','owner','watch','rollback','product-cleanup']]
commands += [[sys.executable,'-B','scripts/net05a-gates.py','--retry-failed'],[sys.executable,'-B','scripts/net05a-export.py','--receipt',str(runtime),'--receipt',str(pair)],[sys.executable,'-B','scripts/net05a-live.py','fixture-cleanup']]
results=[]
def prepare_gate_reuse():
 rows=json.loads((pair/'gates/results.json').read_text());prior=[];(ev/'gates').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 for short,name in [('verify','network-verify'),('race','network-race-postgres')]:
  row=next(g for g in rows if g['gate']==short);assert row['exit']==0
  log=pathlib.Path(row['log']);assert log.parent==pair/'gates' and hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
  shutil.copy2(log,ev/'gates'/(name+'.log'))
  prior.append({'name':name,'command':row['command'],'cwd':str(root),'started_at':row['started'],'finished_at':row['finished'],'exit':0,'expected_exit':0,'status':'pass','expectation_met':True,'log':'gates/'+name+'.log','sha256':row['sha256'],'reuse':'same exact source snapshot; original gate receipt '+str(pair/'gates/results.json')})
 atlas=shutil.which('atlas');assert atlas
 command=[atlas,'migrate','validate','--dir','file://deploy/migrations'];started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();log=ev/'gates/ani-existing-atlas.log'
 with log.open('w') as output:r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=pair/'ani/repo',stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 assert r.returncode==1
 prior.append({'name':'ani-existing-atlas','command':command,'cwd':str(pair/'ani/repo'),'started_at':started,'finished_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'exit':r.returncode,'expected_exit':1,'status':'fail','expectation_met':True,'log':'gates/'+log.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
 seed={'source_pair':str(pair),'required_new_gates':'not_verified','gates':prior,'purpose':'Reuse only actual completed exact-snapshot gate receipts; remaining final gates have not run.'}
 (ev/'exact-snapshot-gate-reuse.json').write_text(json.dumps(seed,indent=2)+'\n')
 (ev/'final-gates.json').write_text(json.dumps(seed,indent=2)+'\n')
with (pair/'live-api-wave.log').open('w') as log:
 for command in commands:
  if 'scripts/net05a-gates.py' in command:prepare_gate_reuse()
  started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();print(json.dumps({'command':command,'event':'start','at':started}),flush=True)
  child=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=root,env=os.environ|{'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'},stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True)
  for line in child.stdout:
   log.write(line);log.flush()
   try:
    event=json.loads(line)
    if event.get('case') in ['product-api','database-snapshot','network-state']:
     event={k:event[k] for k in ['case','at','method','path','code','status','evidence'] if k in event}
    print(json.dumps(event),flush=True)
   except ValueError:print(line,end='',flush=True)
  code=child.wait()
  results.append({'command':command,'started':started,'finished':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'exit':code})
  (ev/'live-api-wave-commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
  if 'scripts/net05a-gates.py' in command and code==0:
   gates=json.loads((ev/'final-gates.json').read_text())
   assert len(gates['gates'])==11 and all(g['expectation_met'] for g in gates['gates'])
  if code:(pair/'live-api-wave.exit').write_text(str(code)+'\n');raise SystemExit(code)
(pair/'live-api-wave.exit').write_text('0\n')
